mapper.select: select R.*, nvl(U.cnt, 0) cnt, 'N' enter from room R left outer join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no order by R.room_no asc

select R.*, nvl(U.cnt, 0) cnt, nvl2(MY.account_id, 'Y', 'N') enter from room R left outer join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no left outer join ( select * from room_user where account_id = #{accountId} ) MY on R.room_no = MY.room_no order by R.room_no asc
select ACC.account_id, ACC.account_nickname, ACC.account_level from room_user RU inner join account ACC on RU.account_id = ACC.account_id where room_no = #{roomNo}
